title: Implement Controller task/attempt loop and deterministic verifier

implementation.activation_provenance: Controller activation accepts only the opaque owned PlanCompilationResult and revalidates canonical plan/evidence digests and validator success; there is no raw PlanIr activation surface.
implementation.controller_authority: Controller exclusively owns task/attempt state, counters, permissions and legal transitions. ModelProposalV1 cannot assert success, task state or permissions.
implementation.derived_readiness: ready is never persisted. ReadyLease is derived from the current plan/task contract, baseline, durable evidence/dependency bindings, checkpoint generation/action sequence/hash, effective permissions, resource admission and execution_epoch.
implementation.durable_evidence: EvidenceSatisfactionV1 binds the exact requirement/query digest, retained current evidence IDs/digests, active plan/task contract and repository snapshot. Machine-executable exact path/literal requirements are supported; arbitrary free-form evidence semantics fail closed. Verified upstream artifact/criterion bindings are created only from passing deterministic verification.
implementation.model_budget: TaskRuntime persists model_calls_consumed and the Controller enforces the compiled resource_budget.max_model_calls before provider dispatch. Caller ModelCallBudget can narrow but cannot refill the task budget. The compiled model deadline is also enforced before dispatch.
implementation.authorized_mutation: The single M1 mutation lowers to the existing T04 AuthorizedAction/ActionJournal/ProcessRunner path with pinned /usr/bin/python3, no shell, no action-supplied PATH and offline isolation. Atomic replacement preserves target mode.
implementation.verification: Deterministic verification binds required acceptance criteria to current-attempt verification steps/evidence types/evaluator, verifies the exact compiled old-to-new relation, exact authorized postimage and repository scope, and is the sole route to task succeeded.
implementation.user_work_preservation: Each attempt captures the pre-attempt repository snapshot/diff and fingerprints all staged/unstaged/untracked protected changes. Verification proves the exact Controller patch is separable while same-target user hunks and unrelated dirty/untracked work remain unchanged.
implementation.result_semantics: A committed action with a durable nonzero process result is execution failure evidence, not an unknown action outcome.
implementation.milestone_boundary: M1-T07 routes eligible failures only to repair_pending. It does not implement M1-T08 RecoveryManager/restart replay or M1-T09's actual second repair model attempt.

completion_evidence.dirty_hunk_preservation: integration test proves same-target user hunk plus unrelated staged, unstaged and untracked work remain byte/diff exact

completion_evidence.dependency_bindings: compiler-produced short-linear plan is blocked before upstream verification, becomes ready after fresh verified bindings, and blocks again when a binding is misbound
